test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the son of B’

Based on the above, how is W related to P if ‘W × V # T – R + P’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife 
 Son 
 
 

 

Given: W × V # T – R + P

It means: W is the wife of V, V is the son of T, T is the brother of R and R is the mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1821bac0c33c520557f7e5c944daf24253d24dea67561a857c3143ec4dddd9e4.png] 

So, W is the '**Mother’s brother’s son’s wife**' of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
